mask_rule.source: Project display mask using an inclusive 0.20 population-probability threshold. The source article illustrates 20% probability surfaces (Figure 3); original full-range probability fields remain available.

probability_interpretation: Source population probability of a tract passing through a template voxel, estimated from HCP young-adult diffusion tractography. Each source field remains independent, including overlapping support.
probability_derivation: Original distributed HCP1065 voxel probabilities are retained exactly. Publisher tracking and population aggregation are upstream source computations; the project derives only the declared display mask.
region_evidence: Diffusion-tractography population inference in the declared source template. The 0.20 contour is a computed display boundary; source probability and template MRI provide its interpretation.
region_notes: The release contains 64 original probability files, including callosal and cingulum subdivisions. The paper main analysis describes 52 pathways; these counts identify different source inventories.
Source probability describes population tractography support. Individual axonal courses and anatomical borders require their own evidence.
The original full MNI T1/T2 files remain preserved. The local display package selects the exact source-aligned crop with unchanged samples.

teaching_sequences.title: Callosal source probability fields
teaching_sequences.objective: Locate the original population fields in the matching T1 and T2 template and compare the named source subdivisions.
teaching_sequences.instruction: Select each source field, inspect its probability through the three native MRI planes, then rotate the complete 0.20 display surface. Switch between probability and binary mask to compare their meanings.
teaching_sequences.evidence_limit: Original diffusion-tractography population inference in ICBM 2009a. The 0.20 surface is the declared display threshold; overlapping source probabilities remain independent.

steps.prompt: Locate Corpus Callosum Body and compare its position with the visible companion source fields.
steps.question: Which original field and side are selected, and how does its probability overlay relate to the 0.20 display surface?

steps.answer: Left Thalamic Radiation Anterior. The overlay retains the original population probability; the displayed surface encloses samples at or above 0.20. Spatial overlap represents independent source fields.

teaching_sequences.title: Visual source probability fields
teaching_sequences.objective: Locate the original population fields in the matching T1 and T2 template and compare the named source subdivisions.
teaching_sequences.instruction: Select each source field, inspect its probability through the three native MRI planes, then rotate the complete 0.20 display surface. Switch between probability and binary mask to compare their meanings.
teaching_sequences.evidence_limit: Original diffusion-tractography population inference in ICBM 2009a. The 0.20 surface is the declared display threshold; overlapping source probabilities remain independent.
